subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Vaccination Nudges
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Vaccination Nudges.

hook.text: A clinic sent patients a text: your flu shot is reserved for Tuesday at 3pm.

buildup.text: Implementation intentions work: specifying when, where, and how increases follow-through.

discovery.text: Milkman showed pre-scheduled appointments and micro-incentives markedly boost vaccination rates more than information.

twist.text: Lottery incentives backfired in some vaccine drives. Paying people signaled the vaccine might be risky, reducing trust.

climax.text: The best vaccination nudge removes friction: close location, easy scheduling, and a specific time.

punchline.text: A scheduled appointment beats a thousand health reminders.

quiz.question: Why did specific appointment texts boost vaccination more than general reminders?
options: Implementation intentions with specific plans increase follow-through
Text messages are always more effective than other media
